Compatibility intelligence

“Good player” is not a position.

A good footballer is not automatically the right footballer. Formation, role, age group, team need and trajectory all matter. Scouts tell ScoutLink what they’re building; ScoutLink compares the evidence against that brief — and explains its reasoning in football terms.

ScoutLink shortlists. Scouts decide. The technology points attention; the football judgement stays human — the scout still watches the player, speaks to the right people and makes the call.

About Stratex

We didn’t start in a boardroom. We started on touchlines.

Stratex exists because opportunity in grassroots football is far too random — and the information that should fix that doesn’t travel.

Meet the leadershipSee what we’re building
The actual story

Coaches know players. Scouts know what they need. Families understand the journey better than anyone gives them credit for. The problem is that all of that useful information gets trapped — in conversations, spreadsheets, WhatsApp messages, memory and local networks.

So whether a talented 14-year-old gets seen can come down to which scout happened to be standing beside which pitch. Talent is not distributed according to who has the best network, the most polished clip or the loudest recommendation — but visibility often is.

Stratex was created to reduce that randomness. Not to replace human judgement — to make sure better evidence can travel further than word of mouth does.

“You should come and watch this kid” is useful. It just isn’t infrastructure.

Data-heavy, football-first. The numbers serve the football — never the other way round.

Trust & safeguarding

Trust isn’t a footer link. It’s part of the product.

ScoutLink involves young players, so the controls are built into how the platform works — not added to the website afterwards.

How Scout verification worksReport a concern
01Reviewed Scout access

Scout accounts are checked and approved before they can view player information. No self-serve access to children’s data.

02Controlled player visibility

Player context is coach-led and permissioned. There is no public, browsable directory of young players.

03Adult-led communication

Interest is routed through coaches, clubs and appropriate adults — never directly to a child.

04Private concern handling

Concerns are logged, reviewed by a named senior person and handled confidentially.

05Data privacy

Player information is collected for football purposes, minimised, and never sold. Details in the privacy policy.

06Account & access controls

Role-based permissions, so people only see what their role in football justifies.

07Where parents fit in

Parents and guardians stay informed and involved — consent where required, visibility over what exists about their child.

08How to report something

Anyone can raise a safeguarding, conduct, privacy or access concern — without knowing the correct category first.

Some friction is intentional. Particularly when the alternative is giving everybody access to everything.

Something you want to check first?

Read the detail, or ask a human before your club commits to anything.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 8 August 2026

On this page 1 · Who we are2 · Information we collect3 · Why we use personal information4 · Registered-user activity tracking5 · Children and player information6 · Scout verification information7 · Compatibility scoring and decision support8 · Lawful basis9 · Who can access personal information10 · Cookies and analytics11 · How long we keep information12 · Your rights13 · Complaints14 · Changes to this policy

ScoutLink is operated by Stratex Analytics Limited, company number 17065022, a company registered in England and Wales.

This Privacy Policy explains how Stratex Analytics Limited uses personal information across Stratex Analytics and ScoutLink.

The plain-English bit

We collect the information needed to run Stratex Analytics and ScoutLink safely. Because ScoutLink involves youth football and young player information, we are especially careful with player data, scout access, safeguarding concerns and user activity on the platform.

We do not sell personal data.

You can contact us if you want to ask what information we hold about you, ask us to correct something, or request deletion where this applies.

1. Who we are

Stratex Analytics Limited is the company responsible for ScoutLink.

ScoutLink is a football scouting and player visibility platform. It helps authorised coaches create structured player profiles and allows approved scouts to review football information through controlled workflows.

For privacy questions, contact: people@stratexanalytics.co.uk

2. Information we collect

We may collect different information depending on how you use Stratex Analytics or ScoutLink.

Account information

This may include:

  • name
  • email address
  • phone number
  • password or login details
  • user role
  • organisation, club, academy, school or team details
  • account status
  • registration declarations and acceptance records

Coach and team information

This may include:

  • coach name and contact details
  • team, club, academy, school or organisation details
  • age group
  • league or competition details
  • player management actions
  • uploaded or edited player information

Scout information

This may include:

  • scout name and contact details
  • proof of identity
  • DBS, Enhanced DBS or relevant safeguarding evidence where applicable
  • verification status
  • approval or decline decision
  • organisation or scouting details
  • acceptance of ScoutLink scout rules and declarations

Player information

This may include:

  • player name
  • age group
  • team, club, academy or school
  • position
  • match facts
  • coach ratings
  • development notes
  • player attributes
  • video evidence where permission exists
  • compatibility or decision-support indicators
  • profile history and updates

Platform activity

When you sign in to ScoutLink, we may record certain account and platform activity. This may include:

  • logins
  • searches
  • page views
  • player profile views
  • video views
  • profile updates
  • uploads
  • notes
  • shortlists
  • interest registrations
  • exports or downloads
  • admin approvals or rejections
  • safeguarding reports and review actions
  • other key account actions

We use this information to operate ScoutLink, keep the platform secure, improve the product, monitor safeguarding risks, investigate misuse and maintain audit trails.

Safeguarding and concern reports

If someone reports a concern, we may collect:

  • concern type
  • urgency
  • names or accounts involved
  • player or team details where relevant
  • description of the concern
  • contact details of the person submitting the report
  • review notes
  • outcome records

Applicant information

If someone applies for a role with Stratex Analytics, we may collect:

  • CV
  • contact details
  • application answers
  • interview notes
  • assessment notes
  • hiring decision records

Website and cookie information

We may collect:

  • cookie preferences
  • device and browser information
  • website usage information
  • analytics information where optional analytics have been accepted

3. Why we use personal information

We use personal information to:

  • provide ScoutLink
  • create and manage accounts
  • verify scout users
  • manage coach and player profiles
  • support scouting workflows
  • operate compatibility and decision-support features
  • protect young players
  • investigate safeguarding or misuse concerns
  • secure the platform
  • maintain audit trails
  • improve the product
  • respond to privacy or support requests
  • manage recruitment
  • comply with legal obligations

4. Registered-user activity tracking

Because ScoutLink involves youth football and young player information, we record certain logged-in activity to help make sure the platform is being used responsibly.

When you register for or use ScoutLink, you acknowledge that we may record account and platform activity such as logins, searches, profile views, video views, uploads, notes, shortlists, interest registrations, exports and key account actions.

We use this information to:

  • operate ScoutLink
  • keep accounts secure
  • protect young players
  • monitor safeguarding risks
  • investigate misuse
  • maintain audit trails
  • improve the product and user experience

This monitoring is part of how ScoutLink operates safely. It is separate from optional website analytics cookies, which can be managed through Cookie Settings.

5. Children and player information

ScoutLink is designed with youth football in mind. That means we apply extra care where information relates to young players.

Player visibility is controlled. Scout access is reviewed. Direct adult-to-child recruitment messaging is not allowed through ScoutLink.

Coaches, clubs, schools and academies should only upload or manage player information where they are authorised and where the correct parent/guardian permissions, notices or internal approvals are in place.

Parents or guardians can contact ScoutLink to ask for a child’s information to be reviewed, corrected, restricted or removed.

6. Scout verification information

Before full scout access is approved, scouts may be asked to upload valid proof of identity and DBS, Enhanced DBS or relevant safeguarding evidence where applicable.

This information is used to review whether scout access should be approved or declined.

DBS or safeguarding evidence forms part of ScoutLink’s access review. It does not replace ScoutLink’s safeguarding rules, monitoring, audit logs or no-direct-contact policy.

We do not aim to keep full DBS certificate copies longer than necessary after a review decision has been made. We may keep a record that evidence was checked, the type of evidence, review date, reviewer, decision and renewal date.

7. Compatibility scoring and decision support

ScoutLink may provide compatibility scores or other decision-support indicators.

These indicators help users review available football evidence. They do not decide whether a player will be selected, signed, trialled or offered an opportunity.

ScoutLink does not guarantee trials, contracts, academy selection, recruitment outcomes or professional opportunities.

8. Lawful basis

Depending on the situation, we may rely on:

  • contract, where we need information to provide ScoutLink
  • legitimate interests, where we need to operate, secure and improve ScoutLink
  • consent, where required for optional analytics or certain content uses
  • legal obligation, where we must comply with the law
  • safeguarding-related reasons where necessary and legally appropriate to protect children or investigate concerns

9. Who can access personal information

Access depends on role and permission.

Personal information may be accessed by:

  • authorised coaches or team users
  • verified scout users where permitted
  • authorised Stratex Analytics admin users
  • technology providers who help us operate the platform
  • professional advisers where needed
  • safeguarding, legal or regulatory authorities where necessary

10. Cookies and analytics

We use essential cookies and similar technologies to keep ScoutLink working.

With your permission, we may also use analytics tools to understand how people use ScoutLink, improve the product and identify issues.

Optional analytics cookies can be accepted or rejected through Cookie Settings.

Cookie choices do not switch off necessary logged-in platform security, safeguarding or audit logs.

11. How long we keep information

We keep personal information only for as long as needed for the purpose it was collected, including legal, safeguarding, audit and operational reasons.

Examples:

  • account records are kept while the account is active and for a reasonable period after closure
  • player profile data is kept while needed for the platform and may be removed where permission is withdrawn or no longer valid
  • safeguarding reports may be kept for longer where needed to protect children, investigate concerns or maintain records
  • scout verification records are kept while access is active and for a reasonable period after access ends
  • DBS or safeguarding evidence should not be kept longer than necessary after review unless legally justified
  • applicant records are usually deleted or anonymised after a defined recruitment period unless permission is given to keep details for future roles

12. Your rights

You may have rights to:

  • access your personal information
  • correct inaccurate information
  • request deletion
  • object to certain processing
  • restrict certain processing
  • withdraw consent where consent is used
  • complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office

To make a request, contact: people@stratexanalytics.co.uk

13. Complaints

You can contact Stratex Analytics first if you have a privacy concern.

You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office.

14. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will be available on the ScoutLink website.

Users should treat ScoutLink as a decision-support platform, not as the only basis for any football decision.

Users must only upload content they are authorised to upload.

By uploading content, users confirm that they have the necessary rights and permissions for ScoutLink to host, display and process that content for platform purposes.

Player data must not be used outside approved ScoutLink workflows unless permission has been obtained.

This Cookie Policy explains how Stratex Analytics Limited uses cookies and similar technologies across the Stratex Analytics website and ScoutLink platform.

What cookies are

Cookies and similar technologies help websites and platforms work, remember preferences, understand usage and keep accounts secure.

Some cookies are necessary for the website or platform to work. Others are optional and help us improve the product.

Essential

Sign-in, account security, session management, fraud and misuse prevention, remembering cookie choices and keeping the platform stable.

Functional

Saved preferences, region or display choices, form progress and remembered settings.

Analytics & performance

Optional analytics that help us understand usage, identify issues and improve ScoutLink.

Marketing

Only used where clearly explained and consented to, and not on player-facing flows unless stated.

1. Essential cookies

Essential cookies and similar technologies are needed to keep the website and platform working.

They may be used for:

  • sign-in
  • account security
  • session management
  • fraud and misuse prevention
  • remembering cookie choices
  • keeping the platform stable

Essential cookies cannot be switched off through ScoutLink cookie settings because the service needs them to work properly.

2. Functional cookies

Functional cookies help remember preferences and improve your experience.

They may be used for:

  • saved preferences
  • region or display choices
  • form progress
  • remembered settings

Where these are not essential, you can manage them through Cookie Settings.

3. Analytics and performance cookies

With your permission, ScoutLink may use analytics tools such as Heap or similar technologies.

These tools help us understand:

  • which pages and features are being used
  • where users get stuck
  • which journeys need fixing
  • how the product can be improved
  • whether important platform flows are working correctly

Analytics is used to improve ScoutLink. It is not used to sell personal data.

Analytics cookies and similar technologies are optional and should only run where you have accepted them.

4. Marketing cookies

ScoutLink does not use marketing cookies on player-facing flows unless clearly explained and consented to.

If marketing cookies are introduced, they will be optional and will be explained in Cookie Settings.

5. Providers

ScoutLink may use trusted providers to help operate, secure and improve the website and platform.

These may include:

  • hosting providers
  • database providers
  • email providers
  • analytics providers where accepted
  • security and platform operations providers

Provider details may change as the product develops. We will update this policy where needed.

6. Duration

Some cookies last only while your browser is open.

Others may last longer so we can remember your choices, keep your account secure or understand product usage where analytics has been accepted.

We will not keep cookies or similar technologies for longer than needed for their purpose.

7. Changing your preferences

You can accept, reject or manage optional cookies through Cookie Settings.

You can change your choice at any time.

Cookie options should include:

  • Accept analytics
  • Reject optional cookies
  • Manage settings
  • Save preferences

8. Important difference between cookies and logged-in activity monitoring

Cookie settings control optional cookies and similar technologies, such as optional analytics.

They do not switch off necessary logged-in platform activity monitoring.

When you register for or use ScoutLink, we may record certain account and platform activity to operate the platform responsibly, protect young players, investigate misuse, maintain audit trails and improve the product.

This may include:

  • logins
  • searches
  • player profile views
  • video views
  • uploads
  • notes
  • shortlists
  • interest registrations
  • exports or downloads
  • admin decisions
  • safeguarding reports and review actions

This monitoring is explained in our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

9. Suggested cookie banner wording

ScoutLink uses essential cookies to keep the platform secure and working.

With your permission, we also use analytics tools to understand how people use ScoutLink, improve the product and identify issues.

When you register or sign in to ScoutLink, we also record certain logged-in activity to operate the platform safely, monitor safeguarding risks, investigate misuse, maintain audit trails and improve the product.

You can accept or reject optional analytics cookies at any time.

Buttons:

  • Accept analytics
  • Reject optional cookies
  • Manage settings

10. Contact

For cookie or privacy questions, contact: people@stratexanalytics.co.uk

Security

Security without the theatre.

What we actually do to protect accounts and information — described plainly, promised carefully.

Authentication & access

Accounts protected by strong authentication; access is role-based and reviewed.

Restricted information

Player information is limited to the people whose football role justifies seeing it.

Private file access

Uploads (video, evidence) are private by default and shared only through permissions.

Secure transport

Data moves over encrypted connections between you and Stratex.

Auditability

Access to sensitive information is logged, so unusual behaviour can be spotted and investigated.

Backup & recovery

Regular backups and a tested path to restore service if something breaks.

Found a vulnerability?

Tell us directly and we’ll take it seriously — people@stratexanalytics.co.uk.

Accessibility

A good experience should work for everyone.

These are the standards we build to across the site and ScoutLink — and what to do if we’ve missed something.

Keyboard navigation

Everything reachable and operable without a mouse, with visible focus.

Screen-reader support

Meaningful names, roles and states on interactive elements.

Semantic structure

Proper headings and landmarks so pages make sense out loud.

Contrast

Text meets WCAG contrast levels — including on the green.

Zoom & text resizing

Layouts hold together at 200% zoom and larger text settings.

Form labels

Every field labelled; errors explained in words, not colour alone.

Alternative text

Images that carry meaning get real descriptions.

Ongoing improvement

Accessibility reviewed as part of building, not audited once a year.

Hit a barrier?

Tell us what happened and where — we’ll fix it or find you another route.

Players

Venue

Structure

Warm-up blocks, then organised matches through the day. Every player gets meaningful minutes.

Player format

How you’re observed

Genuine interest is routed through Stratex to your club and the appropriate adults.

How we actually work
Small team, real ownership

You own outcomes, not tickets. Nobody hands you a slide about synergy.

Remote flexibility

Work where you work best. Show up properly for the moments that need a pitch or a room.

Speak up, make decisions

Opinions are expected. Decisions get made by the person closest to the problem.

Mistakes get discussed

Not hidden. We do the football thing: review it, learn, go again.

Football interest matters

You don’t need coaching badges. You do need to care how the game treats people.

Work reaches users

What you make lands with real coaches and clubs — quickly.

You won’t need fourteen approvals to have an idea. You will need a decent reason for it.

Hiring is deliberately slow-ish and honest: we’d rather you self-select out on this page than three weeks in.

Belonging

A place where people feel welcomed, respected and part of the mission.

Ownership

A team where people are trusted to take initiative and lead from wherever they are.

Growth

An environment where people are challenged, supported and given room to develop.

Courage

A culture where people can speak up, try ideas and learn without fear.
